The '''Kin's Storeroom''' was located in the [[Rahad]] district of [[Ebou Dar]].

==History==
For many years, perhaps for as long as the [[Kin]] have gathered, they collected any item which they perceived as related to the [[One Power]] and placed it in a storeroom in the Rahad.

==Recent Events==
After revealing the [[White Tower]]'s knowledge of the Kin, the [[Knitting Circle]] is asked if they know of any ''[[ter'angreal]]'' in Ebou Dar. They then lead a delegation of [[Aes Sedai]], including [[Elayne Trakand]] and [[Nynaeve al'Meara]], along with [[Matrim Cauthon]] to their storeroom in the Rahad.

Much of what this room contained was junk, and was subsequently discarded. Among this junk however was some ''[[angreal]]'' and a large cache of ''[[ter'angreal]]'', most notably of which was the [[Bowl of the Winds]].

It was during this time that the ''[[gholam]]'' attacked, and it was discovered that Mat's [[foxhead medallion]] could cause harm to [[constructs]].

*Apart from the items described well above, many others are recovered from the stash, but about them we have only some general details:
**many rings, earrings, bracelets, necklaces, clasps, clips and combs decorated with strange patterns
**a lot of brass, bronze, or steel medallions
**some other rods, knifes, and daggers
**many statuettes and figurines in the shape of birds, animals, or people

Aviendha explained that five earring pairs, six rings, three bracelets, a black and white statuette of a bird, and a blue statuette of a woman strangely dressed are all ''ter'angreal'' for long-distance communication.
